sources.note: Formulates adaptive inference-budget allocation as constrained policy optimisation - cap the fraction of queries allowed an expensive response, maximise reward margin subject to that cap - and solves the per-batch cap with an integer linear program whose solution reweights an SFT update.
sources.title: Think Smarter not Harder: Adaptive Reasoning with Inference Aware Optimization

sources.note: ARES trains multimodal reasoning models to spend exploration effort in proportion to problem difficulty, using sliding-window token entropy as the signal for when and how much to explore.
sources.title: ARES: Multimodal Adaptive Reasoning via Difficulty-Aware Token-Level Entropy Shaping
